title: Competing Lenses in Literary Criticism
text:
Literary criticism has long been divided between those who regard a text as a self-contained artifact and those who insist that meaning is inseparable from the historical circumstances of its production. The formalists, for instance, sought to isolate the intrinsic properties of a poem, whereas Marxist critics tended to read the same poem as a symptom of class relations.

Post-structuralist thinkers complicated this picture further by questioning the stability of the author's intention. For them, a text is an interweaving of prior texts, and the reader, rather than the writer, becomes the principal site where meaning is produced. Such arguments unsettled the confident hierarchies on which earlier scholarship had rested.

questions.text: According to the passage, what did the formalists try to do?
options: Explain a poem through its historical class relations
Isolate the intrinsic properties of a poem
Question the stability of the author's intention
Treat the reader as the site where meaning is produced

questions.text: According to the passage, how do post-structuralist thinkers describe a text?
options: As a symptom of class relations
As an interweaving of prior texts

questions.text: What can be inferred about earlier scholarship?
options: It rested on hierarchies that later thinkers challenged
It ignored the existence of readers entirely
It accepted that authors have no intentions
It agreed fully with Marxist interpretations

questions.text: What does the passage imply about the debate between formalist and Marxist critics?
options: It was resolved by post-structuralist thinkers
It concerned whether texts can be separated from their context
It was only about the form of poetry
It had no effect on later criticism

paragraph_translations: Edebi eleştiri uzun süredir iki grup arasında bölünmüş durumda: metni kendi kendine yeten bir yapıt olarak görenler ile anlamın metnin üretildiği tarihsel koşullardan ayrılamayacağını savunanlar. Örneğin biçimciler bir şiirin içsel özelliklerini ayırmaya çalışırken, Marksist eleştirmenler aynı şiiri sınıf ilişkilerinin bir belirtisi olarak okuma eğilimindeydi.

Yapısöküm sonrası düşünürler bu tabloyu daha da karmaşık hale getirdi; yazarın niyetinin istikrarını sorgulayarak. Onlara göre metin, önceki metinlerin iç içe geçmiş bir ağıdır ve anlamın üretildiği başlıca yer yazar değil, okurdur. Bu tür görüşler, önceki araştırmaların dayandığı güvenli hiyerarşileri alt üst etti.
